title: IQ Buster
rules:
General Rules

  • Each team must consist of 2 participants.
  • Participants must report to the venue 15 minutes before the event begins.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, or any electronic devices are strictly prohibited during the event.
  • Any form of unfair means, prompting, or misconduct will result in disqualification.

Round 1: MCQ Round ( Elimination Round)

 All registered teams will participate in this round.

 Each team will receive a question paper containing 20 multiple-choice questions (MCQs).

 Teams must select the correct option and submit the answer sheet within the allotted time.

 Each correct answer carries 1 point and there will be no negative marking.

 Top five teams with the highest scores will qualify for Round 2.

 In case of a tie, the team that submits the answer sheet earlier will be ranked higher. Submission time will be considered only when teams have the same score.

  • Questions will be based on Current Affairs ,General Knowledge Science & Technology, Basic Computer Awareness ,Indian History & Geography ,Indian politics & Constitution (basic level) or Sports.

Round 2: Picture Perfect (Visual Round)

  • Only the top five qualified teams will participate.
  • Images or visual clues will be displayed on the screen.
  • Teams must identify within 30 seconds based on the displayed visual.
  • Questions will be asked to each team in turn.
  • 10 Points will be awarded for every correct answer.
  • The cumulative score of this round will determine the winners.
  • No negative marking
  • Visual clues may be based on Famous personalities, National & International Monuments, Logos of brands, Applications, Organizations,

Flags, Maps, Countries Current Affairs through Images, Indian Culture & Heritage & Sports personalities.
judging:
Winners will be decided based on the highest total score in Round 2.

In case of a tie, a sudden-death question will determine the final rankings.
